_comment: Outbound link templates, in one auditable place.
Every URL the UI can *construct* (as opposed to the URLs that come straight
from the dataset) is assembled from these prefixes, so: (a) there is a single
list to review when a source changes its URL scheme, and (b) no .tsx file
embeds a literal scheme+host. The dataset-sourced links (source_url,
cover_source_url, sources[].url, field_sources[].source_url) are never built
here — they are rendered verbatim from data/anime.json.
